create_MobileNetV2ImageProcessorPil: create a MobileNetV2ImageProcessorPil instance for preprocessing images with ImageNet normalization
run_preprocess_images: run the preprocess method to resize, center crop, rescale, and normalize input images for MobileNetV2
run_preprocess_segmentation_maps: run preprocess with segmentation maps to produce pixel values and labels with nearest-neighbor interpolation
run_reduce_label: run reduce_label to shift segmentation label values by 1, replacing background 0 with 255
run_post_process_semantic_segmentation: run post_process_semantic_segmentation to convert model logits into semantic segmentation maps at target sizes
